tasks.label: 构建：框架依赖版本
tasks.command: $t = Get-Date; Write-Host ('构建：框架依赖版本 ' + $t.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); dotnet publish src/GPGate/GPGate.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o publish; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $file = Get-Item publish/GPGate.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($file) { Write-Host ('产物 ' + $file.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，' + [math]::Round($file.Length / 1KB) + ' KB') }; Write-Host ('构建结束 ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，用时 ' + [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $t).TotalSeconds) + ' 秒，退出码 ' + $code); exit $code

tasks.label: 构建：自包含版本
tasks.command: $t = Get-Date; Write-Host ('构建：自包含版本 ' + $t.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); dotnet publish src/GPGate/GPGate.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o publish-standalone; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $file = Get-Item publish-standalone/GPGate.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($file) { Write-Host ('产物 ' + $file.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，' + [math]::Round($file.Length / 1MB, 1) + ' MB') }; Write-Host ('构建结束 ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，用时 ' + [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $t).TotalSeconds) + ' 秒，退出码 ' + $code); exit $code

tasks.label: 构建：两个版本
tasks.command: $t = Get-Date; Write-Host ('构建：两个版本 ' + $t.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); dotnet publish src/GPGate/GPGate.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o publish; $first = $LASTEXITCODE; dotnet publish src/GPGate/GPGate.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o publish-standalone; $second = $LASTEXITCODE; $small = Get-Item publish/GPGate.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $large = Get-Item publish-standalone/GPGate.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($small) { Write-Host ('框架依赖 ' + $small.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，' + [math]::Round($small.Length / 1KB) + ' KB') }; if ($large) { Write-Host ('自包含 ' + $large.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，' + [math]::Round($large.Length / 1MB, 1) + ' MB') }; $code = if ($first -ne 0) { $first } else { $second }; Write-Host ('构建结束 ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '，用时 ' + [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $t).TotalSeconds) + ' 秒，退出码 ' + $code); exit $code
